purpose: Exploratory semantic-observable model after unsuccessful image and motion baselines
evaluation: Same 5 outer stratified video-hash folds, 4 inner folds, seed 17

encoder.sampling: uniform full-video source PTS, no label anchors or filenames in prompts
encoder.features: 26 fixed observable yes/no/unknown physical scene and action facts
encoder.fingerprint: Exact prompt, schema, sampling, model weights, projector and runtime binary hashes

supervised_head.fit: train-only standardization and regularized logistic coefficients
supervised_head.selection: Inner video OOF balanced accuracy, minimum class recall, larger regularization, simpler family
supervised_head.threshold: Inner OOF balanced accuracy, minimum class recall, nearest 0.5, higher threshold

nested_rules: The pixel-only encoder never sees workbook labels, case identifiers, timestamp anchors, rule decisions or annotation text
Fit every transform and head inside the current training partition
Jointly select feature family, regularization and threshold using inner OOF predictions only
Aggregate outer decisions at each fold's frozen threshold
The final full-data artifact and selection threshold are separate from nested evaluation metrics
Legacy semantic caches with different prompts or sampling are not reused
limits: The same inspected corpus has informed multiple model attempts; nested folds do not undo model-iteration bias
Exact byte hashes do not separate cameras, sessions or near-duplicates
Unknown observations remain distinct from visible negative evidence
Binary predictions do not establish a regulatory category, supervised box or exact event time
